                      HarvesterFactory harvestFactory,

        harvestFactory - reference to factory capable to produce Harvester objects.

      • postEvent

        public <E extends HarvesterEvent> void postEvent​(E event)
        Post an event with hope it will be routed to target scope. An event object needs to implement or be an ancestor of HarvesterEvent. Event is not propagated to all current scopes. Instead it is sent to a scope associated withurl event's Harvester.
        Specified by:
        postEvent in interface Harvest
        Type Parameters:
        E - Type of HarvesterEvent event.
        Parameters:
        event - event to publish.
